_comment: Citation key -> source. ONE guideline source for every accessibility number: the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design (US Department of Justice / US Access Board). Each value was checked against the published text of the standard (the 279-page PDF at https://www.ada.gov/assets/pdfs/2010-design-standards.pdf) on 2026-09-26; the section numbers are in the titles. This is a US federal standard, not the Canadian or Ontario building code: the app shows GUIDELINES only and never claims code compliance.

ada-405-2.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.2 Slope: ramp runs have a running slope not steeper than 1:12
ada-405-2.notes: Verified in the published text. Existing sites may use up to 1:8 with limited rise (Table 405.2); the app does not use that exception.

ada-405-6.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.6 Rise: the rise of any ramp run is 30 inches (760 mm) maximum
ada-405-6.notes: Verified in the published text. A ramp that needs more rise is split into runs joined by landings.

ada-405-5.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.5 Clear Width: 36 inches (915 mm) minimum, and where handrails are provided, 36 inches minimum between handrails

ada-405-7.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.7 Landings: 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum clear length (405.7.3); a change of direction needs a clear landing of 60 x 60 inches minimum (405.7.4)
ada-405-7.notes: Verified in the published text. 405.7 also wants landings at the top and bottom of each run: the app treats the porch as the top landing and level ground as the bottom one.

ada-405-8.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.8 Handrails: ramp runs with a rise greater than 6 inches (150 mm) have handrails

ada-505-4.title: 2010 ADA Standards 505.4 Height: top of the handrail gripping surface is 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum above the walking surface
ada-505-4.notes: Verified in the published text. The app uses 36 inches, the middle of the range.

ada-405-9.title: 2010 ADA Standards 405.9 Edge Protection: on each side of ramp runs and landings, either the surface extends 12 inches (305 mm) beyond the inside face of the handrail, or a curb or barrier stops a 4 inch (100 mm) sphere where any part of it is within 4 inches of the surface

ada-308-reach.title: 2010 ADA Standards 308 Reach Ranges: low reach 15 inches (380 mm) minimum (308.2.1); a side reach over an obstruction allows the obstruction 34 inches (865 mm) maximum high and 24 inches (610 mm) maximum deep (308.3.2)
ada-308-reach.notes: Verified in the published text. Used to set the raised bed's height range (15 to 34 inches) and reach depth from one side (24 inches). A bed reachable from both sides is twice that (48 inches): derived, not stated in the standard.

ada-403-5-1.title: 2010 ADA Standards 403.5.1 Clear Width: walking surfaces on an accessible route are 36 inches (915 mm) minimum wide
ada-403-5-1.notes: Verified in the published text. It has a limited exception to 32 inches for up to 24 inches of length.

ada-504-2.title: 2010 ADA Standards 504.2 Treads and Risers: risers 4 inches (100 mm) minimum and 7 inches (180 mm) maximum; treads 11 inches (280 mm) deep minimum
ada-504-2.notes: Verified in the published text. 504.3 also forbids open risers (the step platform uses closed risers). The app checks the 7 inch maximum and the 11 inch minimum but not the 4 inch minimum riser.

local-code-notice.title: Local building code and permit requirements
local-code-notice.publisher: Your municipal building department (not reviewed by this app)
local-code-notice.notes: A reminder, not a numeric rule: check whether your project needs a permit, and which code applies where you live (in Ontario, the Ontario Building Code and the AODA). The numbers above come from the US ADA Standards and may differ from your local code.

site-fit.title: Computed from your design and the site length you entered
site-fit.notes: Geometry, not a guideline: the ramp's footprint (runs plus landings) must fit the length available.

lumber-stock-lengths.title: Board lengths sold (backend/app/data/lumber.json)
lumber-stock-lengths.notes: The longest board a retailer sells for the chosen framing. Lengths were checked against Home Depot Canada (homedepot.ca) on 2026-09-26; a length the store does not sell is left out and its pieces are cut from the next longer board.
